components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary clinical action for ordinary high-priority interactions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent-teal); color: #fff; padding: 0.6875rem 1.75rem; min-height: 48px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-accent-teal); border-radius: 8px; font: 500 0.9375rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-800); border-color: var(--color-primary-800); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(55, 138, 221, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--color-primary-400); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Registration CTA
components.description: Warm, unmistakable action for online registration and booking.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { background: var(--color-cta); color: var(--color-cta-text); padding: 0.6875rem 1.75rem; min-height: 48px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-cta); border-radius: 8px; font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: var(--color-cta-dark); border-color: var(--color-cta-dark); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(208, 149, 0, 0.3); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--color-primary-400); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Quietly elevated container for services, doctors, news, and supporting information.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-neutral-900); padding: 1rem; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary-100); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(2, 48, 71, 0.04); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font: 600 1.125rem/1.3 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-neutral-600); font: 400 0.875rem/1.65 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact, readable field for patient and administrative forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; color: var(--color-neutral-900); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.2 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-neutral-200); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-neutral-900); font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary-400); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-accent-teal); outline: 2.5px solid var(--color-primary-400); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky deep-blue orientation bar with active-route clarity.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--color-primary-800); } .ds-nav a { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--color-primary-200); text-decoration: none; font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav-active { color: var(--color-primary-50) !important; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); }

narrative.overview:
The interface presents the hospital as a dependable point of orientation: calm enough to reduce anxiety, direct enough to help patients act quickly, and precise enough to support real care decisions. It uses a light clinical canvas with a deep navy anchor, a sky-blue information scale, and a warm amber action signal.

The visual language is simple, modern, and professional. It favors clear hierarchy, familiar web patterns, and practical density over ornament. Rounded controls and cards soften the clinical setting without becoming luxurious; motion is brief and functional, used to reveal content and confirm state rather than entertain.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy structure with sky-blue information accents
Amber reserved for high-value patient actions
Figtree headings paired with Inter body copy
Rounded, touch-friendly controls and restrained depth
Clear, non-luxurious and non-playful clinical presentation

rules.name: The Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber should identify a patient action or meaningful warning, never become a general decorative wash.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Figtree to orient and Inter to explain; do not turn body copy into display typography.

rules.name: The Calm Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation should clarify hierarchy or state; never use large, glossy shadows to simulate luxury.

dos: Do use deep navy to establish trust and structure.
Do reserve amber for actions, warnings, and moments that deserve attention.
Do keep headings in Figtree and explanatory copy in Inter.
Do preserve visible focus states and touch-friendly minimum heights.
Do use tonal layering and restrained shadows to keep the interface calm.
donts: Don't introduce luxury cues such as metallic finishes, ornate typography, or glossy gradients.
Don't add playful illustrations, novelty motion, or decorative clutter that competes with care information.
Don't make the interface bureaucratic with dense tables, unexplained labels, or long unbroken instruction blocks.
Don't use amber as a general background or treat danger colors as brand accents.
Don't remove the active route, skip link, or keyboard focus signals in pursuit of minimalism.
